1. ~~Identify [CRI changes needed for UpdateContainerResources API](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/686#discussion_r248019362), define response message for UpdateContainerResources~~
    - ~~Extend UpdateContainerResources API to return info such as ‘not supported’, ‘not enough memory’, ‘successful’, ‘pending page evictions’ etc.~~
   - ~~Define [expected behavior for runtime](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/686#discussion_r297226461) when UpdateContainerResources is invoked. Define timeout duration of the CRI call.~~
      - Resolution: _Separate KEP for CRI changes._
        - _Discussed draft CRI changes with SIG-Node on Oct 22, and we agreed to do this as an incremental change outside the scope of this KEP, in a new mini-KEP. It does not block implementation of this KEP._

1. Define behavior when multiple containers are being resized, [and UpdateContainerResources fails](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/686#discussion_r271414394) for one or more containers.
    - One Possible solution:
      - Do not update Status.Resources.Limits if UpdateContainerResources API fails, and keep retrying until it succeeds.

1. ~~Check with API reviewers [if we can keep maps instead list of named sub-objects](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/686#discussion_r318238266) for ResizePolicy.~~
    - After discussion with @liggitt , we are going to use list of named subobjects for extensibility.

1. Can we find a [more intuitive name](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/686#discussion_r325445875) for ResizePolicy?

1. Can we use [ResourceVersion to figure out the ordering](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/686#discussion_r318279477) of Pod resize requests?

1. ~~Do we [need to add back the ‘RestartPod’](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/686#discussion_r326999056) resize policy? Is there a strong use-case for it?~~ 
    - Resolution: _No._
      - _Discussed with SIG-Node on Oct 15th, not adding RestartPod policy for simplicity, will revisit if we encounter problems._

---

**Alpha Feature Code Issues:**
These are Items and issues discovered during code review that need further discussion and need to be addressed before Beta.
1. ~~Can we figure out GetPodQOS differently once it is determined on pod create? See https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/102884#discussion_r663280487~~
    - Fixed by https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/119665
1. How do we deal with a pod that requests 1m/1m cpu requests/limits. See https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/102884#discussion_r662552642
1. Add internal representation of ContainerStatus.Resources in kubeContainer. Convert it to ContainerStatus.Resources in kubelet_pods generate functions. See https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/102884#discussion_r662534632 and https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/102884#discussion_r663151422 and https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/102884#discussion_r663300123
1. Can we get rid of resize mutex? Is there a better way to handle resize retries? See https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/102884#discussion_r663160060 
1. Can we recover from resize checkpoint store failures? See  https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/102884#discussion_r663245975
1. CRI clarification for ContainerStatus.Resources and how to handle runtimes that don't support it. See https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/102884#discussion_r663300347
1. ~~Add real values to dockershim test for ContainerStatus.Resources https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/102884#discussion_r662521121~~
    - Resolution: Not required due to dockershim deprecation. 
1. ~~Change PodStatus.Resources from v1.ResourceRequirements to *v1.ResourceRequirements~~
    - Resolution: Fixed 
1. Address all places in the code that has 'TODO(vinaykul)'
1. Current implementation does not work with node toploogy manager enabled. This limitation is not capturedi in the KEP. Add this to the release documentation for alpha, we will address this in beta. See https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/102884#discussion_r676806049
